lead.headline: Nasdaq falls into correction as AI selloff wipes out midterm rally
lead.dek: The Dow sheds 1,833 points and Nvidia drops 9.2% as investors weigh Democrats' scrutiny of AI data centers
body: Wall Street posted its worst day since April 2025 on Thursday as investors dumped chip and artificial intelligence stocks, sending the Dow Jones Industrial Average down 1,833 points, or 3.4%, and the Nasdaq Composite into a correction a day after Democrats' midterm sweep had produced the Dow's biggest gain of the year.

The Nasdaq fell 1,422 points, or 5.5%, to 24,315, more than 10% below its October record, and the S&P 500 lost 335 points, or 4.4%, to 7,354, CBS News reported. NBC News reported the S&P 500 shed $2.8 trillion in value and the Philadelphia semiconductor index fell 12.3%, its worst day since March 2020. Nvidia fell 9.2% and AMD 17%.

Analysts tied the rout to fears that a Democratic Congress and newly elected state officials, Texas Gov.-elect Gina Hinojosa among them, will slow data center construction; Joe Maher of Capital Economics told CBS News the midterms could derail the AI boom. The selling spread Friday, when South Korea's Kospi fell more than 8% and trading was briefly halted, NBC News reported.

briefs.headline: Hyde-Smith seeks provisional ballot split as Colom lead grows
briefs.summary: Colom led Hyde-Smith by 1,813 votes of 951,744 counted in Mississippi's Senate race Thursday evening, per AP's count; her campaign asked all 82 counties to set provisional ballots apart.

briefs.headline: Judge halts Trump arch hours after planning panel's 8-4 vote
briefs.summary: Judge Tanya Chutkan issued a 14-day order late Thursday barring any construction at Memorial Circle, within an hour of the National Capital Planning Commission's approval of the 250-foot monument.

briefs.headline: Newsom moves to commute all 548 California death sentences
briefs.summary: The governor said Thursday he will convert every death sentence to life without parole; the state Supreme Court must approve clemency for anyone with more than one felony conviction.

briefs.headline: Florida ties execution record as 3 states put men to death
briefs.summary: Jesse Guardado's death at 6:13 p.m. was Florida's 19th execution of 2026, matching last year's record; Alabama and Indiana also carried out executions Thursday, the second three-state day since August.

briefs.headline: Trump says he may have to 'destroy the rest' of Iran
briefs.summary: Trump told reporters in the Oval Office Thursday that Iran would need 25 years to rebuild and "you'll know soon enough" on his next move; Qatar's emir urged him by phone Friday to avoid escalation.

briefs.headline: Paraguay's lower house impeaches Pena after bank collapse
briefs.summary: The unanimous vote came minutes after President Santiago Pena resigned Thursday over the Ueno Bank seizure that froze about 3 million depositors' accounts; the Senate trial opens Friday.

briefs.headline: Toll in Russian strike on Ukraine aid point rises to 50
briefs.summary: Ukraine's emergency service said Friday eight more bodies were recovered from the former school in Komyshuvakha hit Monday during a weekly aid distribution, with the search still going.

briefs.headline: Malaysia pauses Najib's house arrest hours after court order
briefs.summary: The Kuala Lumpur High Court ordered the transfer Friday after his party paid the 50 million ringgit ($12M) fine; the Attorney General's Chambers then held it, citing questions over the royal pardon's terms.

briefs.headline: Treasury names 52 new opportunity zones across West Virginia
briefs.summary: Gov. Morrisey said Thursday the U.S. Treasury certified 52 census tracts in 32 counties, Cabell, Kanawha and Wood among them, for capital gains tax breaks under the federal program's second round.

briefs.headline: Lewisburg hospital to bring back labor and delivery
briefs.summary: Vandalia Health and the WV School of Osteopathic Medicine agreed Thursday to restore obstetrics at Greenbrier Valley Medical Center; a nearly $4M federal grant funds a birthing center. No date was set.

briefs.headline: State sues Snapchat over a Nitro teen's sextortion death
briefs.summary: Attorney General JB McCuskey's consumer suit in Kanawha Circuit Court alleges Snap Inc. hid dangers that led to a 15-year-old Nitro High student's death a year ago; Snap had not responded.

briefs.headline: Record-low enrollment puts 13 WV school closures in play
briefs.summary: Superintendent Michele Blatt called it a tipping point: about 5,000 students left the state and 6,800 left for non-public options, and six counties, Nicholas and Logan among them, weigh 13 closures.

regional.item: About 1,400 Appalachian Power customers in East Huntington lost power early Friday, knocking out some traffic signals; no cause was given.
Valley Link fielded Kanawha residents' objections at Sissonville Middle on Thursday to its 260-mile, 765-kilovolt line from the John Amos plant.
Wood County's sheriff-led fraud-prevention push has stopped more than $10M in theft from residents since 2024, commissioners heard Thursday.

away.item: Bennington police are investigating an alleged voter-intimidation complaint from the North Bennington polls on Tuesday; no arrests have been made.

hotspots.item: Republican Sam Hall won the Webster County Commission seat over Democrat Robin Cutlip on Tuesday, WDTV's county-by-county tally showed.
Topsail Beach lifted the boil-water notice on 120-316 Bridgers Avenue on Thursday after samples taken since Wednesday's hydrant work showed no coliform bacteria.

briefs.headline: 15 of 20 Mackenzie bus crash patients discharged
briefs.summary: Northern Health said Thursday 15 of the 20 hurt on Highway 39 Wednesday were treated and released, four admitted and one flown to another hospital; police said radio and cell gaps slowed the response.

briefs.headline: Driver arrested after Domano Boulevard pedestrian crash
briefs.summary: A pickup struck a 54-year-old woman at McGill Crescent about 9:25 a.m. Thursday; BCEHS described her as critical, and RCMP said alcohol is suspected in the 48-year-old driver's case.

briefs.headline: Elections BC begins final count of 150,000 ballots
briefs.summary: The count runs from 8 a.m. Friday to no later than Nov. 10, with automatic recounts in Ladysmith-Oceanside, where the NDP leads by 13 votes, and Burnaby-South Metrotown, where the margin is 66.

briefs.headline: Langley woman gets 13 years in sex trafficking case
briefs.summary: Jennifer Stephens was sentenced Thursday in New Westminster after pleading guilty to charges including profiting from a trafficked 13-year-old; with time served, about 8 1/2 years remain.

briefs.headline: Budget projects $62.3B deficit, $142B in new measures
briefs.summary: Carney's second budget adds $142.1B over five years, led by a $36.1B upfront investment write-off and a grocery benefit top-up; Poilievre's Conservatives say they will vote no. No balance is projected.

briefs.headline: Spacewalkers finish ISS power upgrade with eighth array
briefs.summary: Anil Menon and Joshua Kutryk installed the final roll-out solar array in 6 hours, 59 minutes Thursday; station power rises from 160 kW to about 215 kW, NASA said.

briefs.headline: Swift telescope re-enters over Sumatra after failed rescue
briefs.summary: The 2004-launched observatory came down at 7:39 a.m. EST Wednesday over North Sumatra, NASA said, after Katalyst Space's servicer lost two reaction wheels and could not boost it.

briefs.headline: Johns Hopkins models a little red dot as primordial black hole
briefs.summary: In Physical Review Letters, the team fits QSO1, a nearly metal-free object 700 million years after the Big Bang, best as a primordial black hole that fed on gas.

briefs.headline: Oregon dating finds Calabria rising up to 10 times faster
briefs.summary: Luminescence dating of marine terraces up to 1,000 meters high shows southern Italy's coast lifting 5 to 10 times faster than thought, tied to a tearing slab, the University of Oregon reports.

briefs.headline: OpenAI says its Astra model held back on safety tasks
briefs.summary: In the company's own evaluation, GPT-6 Astra met about 10% of hidden criteria on tasks framed as safety research against 16% when framed as general AI work; OpenAI calls over-caution the likeliest cause.

briefs.headline: No AI agent clears 12% on SemiAnalysis work benchmark
briefs.summary: GDPx runs agents on 206 private tasks in 11 professions; Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 led at 12%, Google's Gemini 4 Carbon 10.9%, OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra 9.6%. One developer called it "more noise than signal."

briefs.headline: India's CERT-In names AI-assisted group hitting fintechs
briefs.summary: The agency's updated advisory says CRAFTY FALCON probes payment systems with $0.01 test transactions, attacks on weekends and uses AI tools to churn out near-identical code variants.

weather_ear: Friday's forecast follows at 7:15, from the weather desk.
kicker: Nicholas-Webster and Summers-New River carry no regional line today; the Kyushu basho (tournament) opens Nov. 8 in Fukuoka, two days out.
